reason: A web UI plugin for listing installed skins, switching the active appearance, and restoring the default theme through a settings page and local configuration files.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的设置界面中管理已安装皮肤，支持一键切换和恢复官方默认外观。
summaries.en: Manage installed DeepSeek Harness Web GUI skins from a settings page with one-click switching and restoration of the default appearance.

capabilities: Adds a skin-selection page to the web settings interface
Discovers installed legacy and v2 skin assets
Writes local skin activation and managed configuration files
Provides local API routes for skin state and switching
Triggers configuration reloads and page refreshes after switching
